Releases

Every published version of Faber and Radix. Each entry links to a page with pinned install instructions for that exact version and its full release notes.

Installing for the first time? Use Install — it covers the current release only, which is what almost everyone wants.

Reading this table#

A dash under Downloads means no prebuilt archive was published for that version — it is listed because its release notes are part of the record. A dash under Notes means the version shipped but its notes have not been backfilled yet.

Radix source is closed for now; its published artifacts are the compiler binary and checksums. See Open source.
